systems.system: West African Police Information System (WAPIS) database
systems.owner: not stated; installation in northern Ghana supported by the European NORPREVSEC project, implemented by FIIAPP, with a WAPIS team and INTERPOL taking part
systems.tiers: the first WAPIS computer was installed at the regional Judicial Police Unit in Tamale and is reported fully operational as at October 2023; the project supports installation across the five northern regions and trained 25 trainees of the security agencies to enter information

note: No fact: the document describes WAPIS as a database for collecting, analysing and exchanging information between security agencies, with one terminal at a regional judicial police unit in Tamale; it never says that stations enter reports or cases in it when they take them, so the class is left empty.
